Three steps approved. Starting with the store unit: reading how the live futon1b unit sets its JVM flags so the scratch store matches, then the brief and the Facts wiring.The store is up under the unit with the 2 GB heap and exit-on-OOM in place. Now wiring the Facts section: minus40 facts about the mission, read through m40's own cache, never failing the brief.The test's cap assertion was mine and wrong (cap=1 keeps the newest, "d"). Fixing it, then committing, rendering the real brief, checking the loops, and recording the unit in the minus40 repo.The extra terms I passed matched minus40's own test-project memories by their ids. Rendering again with just the mission and excursion terms for the honest count, then recording.㊥ (gist) All three steps are done and checked. The minus40 scratch store now runs as a user unit with a 2 GB heap, exit on out-of-memory and restart on failure. The session brief is enabled for every seat. The resume brief's Facts section reads minus40 and shows three facts for M-象-2000 live. Commits: futon3c bcbe204c8 and 9c207fc26, minus40 592e0a3.

㊢ (store as a unit) `minus40-store.service` replaced the ad hoc scope at 17:40:50Z and answered health 18 s later. The JVM command line carries the 2 GB heap after the alias's 1 GB, so the override took. The follower, relate and fault loops kept running through the restart, and a fresh `net-changed` over 10-13 to 10-14 answers in 2.4 s. The unit file is kept in minus40 under `scripts/systemd/` with the outage written into the README.

㊢ (brief for all seats) `brief-enabled.txt` now reads `all`, with the old one-seat list kept beside it. A dry run as claude-16 produced about 3,900 characters: open asks with no answer linked, then recently changed memory. One thing to watch: that list shows my own reply paragraphs from this morning as asks by claude-16, because marked agent replies are read as acts. Whether an agent's 🈸 should count as an open ask is a question for the brief's author, not a fault in it.

㊢ (Facts in the resume brief) The section loads m40.py itself, so it shares minus40's store, ten-minute cache and true-at rule. It keeps facts true now whose text or memory id mentions the mission id or its excursions, newest first, up to 15. When the store is down it falls back to the cache on disk and says so; it never fails the brief. For M-象-2000 it finds three: read-the-clock, zai-five-hour-window and minus40-memory-store, in 1.0 s. Test added, five pass.

㊩ (seen on the way) The scratch store holds minus40's own test projects, the corner-store bench and the hooktest memories, so a broad term like `minus40` matches them by id and fills the section with fixtures. I left that alone; cleaning test projects out of the store is minus40's call.

㊢ (still open from this morning) The live futon1b on :7073 is still in its GC spiral, and that is the one restart I did not make, since it is the shared store and your call.

previous_reply_acts.text: ("can be brought online") The scratch store on :7093 runs with a 1 GB heap in a `systemd-run` scope. From 03:03Z today its accept queue was full and every connection timed out. The ingest hook logged 826 timeouts and advanced no state. The follower's open view froze at 02:55Z. Its liveness port kept answering 200, so no check noticed. A new scope started the store at 17:30:58Z, not from this seat, and the follower resumed at 17:34Z. This is the same failure shape futon1b had on 07-13, and the fix applied there, exit on out-of-memory plus restart on failure, is not on this store's command line.

previous_reply_acts.author: claude-16
previous_reply_acts.text: ("fully integrated") minus40 is integrated with Claude Code sessions through two hooks, ingest on every tool call and a session-start brief, but the brief is enabled for claude-15 only, so this seat gets none. On the futon3c side there is no integration: no code under `src/`, `emacs/` or `scripts/` references minus40, and the 象 resume brief's Facts section prints a stub saying no minus40 fact was read. The two memory systems share a design and a store engine but do not read each other.

Enable the session brief for all seats, or at least mine, and watch one week of briefs. Wire the resume brief's Facts section to `m40 asof` over the mission's seats, which is the first place 象 and M40° would actually meet.
